parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const items=Array.isArray(input.items)?input.items:[]; const now=Date.now(); const s=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const n=v=>{const x=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(x)?x:null}; const score=n(x.opportunity_score??x.deal_score)??0; const due=x.due_at?new Date(x.due_at).getTime():null; const overdue=due!==null&&!Number.isNaN(due)&&due<now; const urgency=overdue?30:due!==null&&!Number.isNaN(due)&&due-now<86400000?20:0; const blocker=(x.blocker||x.missing_requirement)?15:0; const priority=Math.min(100,Math.round(score*.55+urgency+(stageBoost[stage]??0)+blocker)); return{record_id:x.record_id??x.deal_id??x.lead_id??x.property_id??null,stage,opportunity_score:score,priority_score:priority,overdue,next_action:x.next_action??(overdue?'Resolve overdue item':stage==='closing_pending'?'Coordinate closing':'Review and advance highest-value next step'),reason_codes:[overdue?'overdue':null,stage?'stage_'+stage:null,score>=85?'high_opportunity':null,blocker?'blocked_or_missing_data':null].filter(Boolean)};}).sort((a,b)=>b.priority_score-a.priority_score).map((x,i)=>({...x,rank:i+1}));
